entries.4fefc6e8d7a9432b: In the interior and furniture industry, the company views the environment as highly competitive, with continued increases in rent for warehouses, stores and offices, delivery costs, raw material prices and personnel costs due to labor shortages. Against this backdrop, it is focusing on differentiation from competitors by expressing its own “character” through the spread of inner branding.
entries.5337e5b6de9dbc27: Its distinguishing features are a store-development approach that sets a theme for each store without standardizing or uniforming stores, and a structure in which it plans and develops almost all of its furniture and fabric products in-house. It says it selects appropriate partner factories for each series according to material and structure, and balances price with design and function, thereby achieving prices commensurate with added value.
